description: This Java class 'ProductStoreWorker' provides store-related utility functions for the OFBiz e-commerce framework, including product store retrieval, inventory checks, shipping methods, and surveys.

classes.name: ProductStoreWorker
classes.description: Utility class for store-related operations in OFBiz, including product store retrieval, inventory checks, shipping methods, and surveys.

methods.name: getProductStore
methods.description: Retrieves a product store entity by ID using the delegator.

methods.name: getProductStore
methods.description: Retrieves the current product store based on the request context.

methods.name: getProductStoreId
methods.description: Gets the product store ID from the session or website context.

methods.name: getStoreCurrencyUomId
methods.description: Returns the default currency UOM ID for the store.

methods.name: getStoreLocale
methods.description: Returns the locale setting for the store.

methods.name: getStoreTimeZone
methods.description: Returns the timezone setting for the store.

methods.name: determineSingleFacilityForStore
methods.description: Determines if the store uses a single inventory facility.

methods.name: autoSaveCart
methods.description: Checks if the store is configured to auto-save carts.

methods.name: getProductStorePayToPartyId
methods.description: Gets the pay-to party ID for the store.

methods.name: getProductStorePaymentProperties
methods.description: Retrieves payment properties path for the store based on payment method and service type.

methods.name: getProductStorePaymentSetting
methods.description: Fetches payment setting entity for the store based on payment method and service type.

methods.name: getProductStoreShipmentMethods
methods.description: Retrieves shipment methods for the store based on shipment type and carrier info.

methods.name: getProductStoreShipmentMethod
methods.description: Gets a specific shipment method for the store.

methods.name: getAvailableStoreShippingMethods
methods.description: Filters available shipping methods based on address, item sizes, features, and geos.

methods.name: getRandomSurveyWrapper
methods.description: Selects a random survey wrapper for the store, optionally based on group.

methods.name: getProductSurveys
methods.description: Retrieves surveys associated with a product in the store.

methods.name: getSurveys
methods.description: Fetches surveys for the store, filtered by product, category, or group.

methods.name: checkSurveyResponse
methods.description: Counts responses for a survey by party.

methods.name: isStoreInventoryRequired
methods.description: Checks if inventory is required for a product at the store.

methods.name: isStoreInventoryAvailable
methods.description: Checks if inventory is available for a product at the store.

methods.name: isStoreInventoryRequiredAndAvailable
methods.description: Determines if inventory is required and available for a product.

methods.name: isStoreInventoryAvailable (overloaded for ProductConfigWrapper)
methods.description: Checks inventory availability for a product configuration.
